# ZothOS Linux v3.2 — Machine-Readable LLM Context (llms.txt)
> The Sovereign AI, Cryptographic Vault & Offensive Security Operating System
> Engineered by Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30) • NullAI Platform (https://nullai.tech)

## Core Architecture
- **Base Distribution**: Debian 13 (Trixie) with surgical APT pinning for Kali Rolling & Parrot OS Security (175+ offensive security tools).
- **Desktop Environment**: KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland with custom 24K Celtic Gold theme, interactive `org.zothos.interactive` 3D wallpaper, and `zoth-cursor-daemon` 60 FPS compositor cursor tracking.
- **Pre-Installed Frontier AI Agents (9)**: Google Antigravity (`agy`), Claude Code (`claude`), Grok CLI (`grok-bot`), Aider (`aider`), Cursor AI (`cursor`), Cline (`cline`), Nous Hermes (`hermes`), OpenAI Codex (`codex`), and local Ollama (`ollama serve` on `127.0.0.1:11434`).
- **22 Loopback Enclave Daemons**: Bound strictly to `127.0.0.1` ports `:8094` through `:8120`, `:9393` (`zoth-civilization`), `:5225` (`simplex-chat`), and `:8787` (`zoth-vault-daemon`).
- **Reality Pill Profiles (`zoth-mode`)**: `gold` (24K Sovereign Gold Default), `ghost` (NullAI Ghostmode + Transparent Tor + MAC Spoofing), `matrix` (Hermetic Emerald Phosphor), `incognito` (Covert Chameleon).
- **Hardware & Thermal Invariants**: `<55.0°C` CPU thermal ceiling, `0 RPM` whisper-quiet passive fan curve, `no_turbo=1` lock, and `zoth-heal` autonomous self-healing daemon.
